messages.content: What are the calories of a Big Mac?

function.name: calculate_bmi
function.description: Calculate the Body Mass Index for a person based on their height and weight Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

height.description: The height of the person in meters. This is a float type value.

weight.description: The weight of the person in kilograms. This is a float type value.

unit.description: The unit of measure. Defaults to metric units (kilograms/meters). Other option is imperial (pounds/inches).

message.content:
A standard McDonald’s Big Mac contains **about 550 kcal** (calories).  
That figure is for the U.S. menu item; the exact number can vary slightly by country or by any menu‑item changes McDonald’s makes over time. If you’re looking for the most up‑to‑date nutrition facts for your local McDonald’s, you can check the official McDonald’s website or the in‑store nutrition guide.
